_meta.description: Crash Early Warning System — complement to bull/rate-pivot framework. NOT the arithmetic inverse of L1 (which is concurrent r=0.563). EWS uses leading leverage/funding dynamics that fire 3-6 months early. Designed by Opus High Council 2026-07-12.
_meta.design_rule: Do not build EWS as inverse of L1. L1 is concurrent — inverting it gives a lagging crash signal that fires at the bottom, not the top.

leading_block_max_2.margin_pt: Margin debt YoY >50% AND absolute near/above prior peak (post-crash YoY gated by absolute level — NOT raw YoY to prevent false positives in recovery years)
leading_block_max_2.cb_bond_pt: CB issuance YoY >40% AND RE/Construction bond share rising (concentrated funding channel = fragility)

divergence_block_max_1.desc: L1 score falling 3-month trend while VNINDEX still rising, OR EW A3 vs VNINDEX gap < -5pp (breadth rot / cap-weight distortion)

confirming_block_max_1.desc: CBFS >= AMBER, OR L1 absolute score <3/8, OR breadth <40%

_meta.rationale: L1 8-criterion composite is a concurrent classifier (r=0.563 same-year, r=0.110 lagged). Binary level-checks flip AT the pivot, not before it. Predictive content lives in derivatives (momentum, direction, diffusion). Council redesign: 2 hard gates + 2 leading signals in AND-cascade.
_meta.statistical_basis: EM rate-cycle literature: market rates lead policy (4-8wk). FX is hard veto in managed-float EMs (Calvo-Reinhart fear-of-floating). Taylor-level inputs (inflation gap) are concurrent. Credit aggregates lag universally.

pruned_criteria.C1_headline_CPI: DEMOTED — noisy (food/fuel base effects), redundant to C2 Core. Fold into G1 inflation gate as a non-accelerating check only.

pruned_criteria.C8_credit_deposit_gap: DEMOTED — lagging/structural. Credit aggregates lag universally in EM literature. Retain as background context note, not a scoring criterion.

tier1_gates.description: Binary vetoes. Signal score = 0 if EITHER gate fails regardless of Tier 2.

G1_fx_veto.name: FX Permission Gate
G1_fx_veto.threshold: USD/VND no new 20-day high AND within SBV central-rate band. C4+C7 are inputs to FX pressure, not standalone gates.
G1_fx_veto.causal_logic: SBV cannot cut if VND is under attack — fear-of-floating veto. Any domestic easing signal is nullified by FX pressure.
G1_fx_veto.current_note: Vietcombank sell 26,450 on 16-Jul is below the observed 30-Jun 20-day-window high of 26,466 and inside the SBV ceiling of 26,505. Free-market premium versus Vietcombank is about 0.57%. Trade and foreign-flow pressure remain adverse inputs, so this pass must be monitored rather than treated as durable.

G2_inflation_permission.name: Inflation Permission Gate
G2_inflation_permission.threshold: 3m-annualized core CPI momentum NOT accelerating AND below 4.5% ceiling trajectory
G2_inflation_permission.causal_logic: SBV has explicit CPI ≤4.5% political mandate. Cannot cut if inflation trajectory is rising toward target breach. Use 3m momentum, NOT YoY level (lagging base effects).
G2_inflation_permission.current_note: Q2 core CPI momentum decelerated to about 5.57% 3m annualized from about 6.76% in Q1, but remains above the 4.5% ceiling trajectory. G2 therefore still fails despite improvement.

tier2_leading_signals.description: Continuous 0-100 score. Valid ONLY when both Tier 1 gates pass. Uses derivatives, not levels.

P1_omo_interbank_momentum.name: SBV Operational Easing Signal

sub_components.a_omo_net_trend: OMO net injection positive AND rising ≥3 consecutive weeks (40% of P1 sub-weight) — SBV's real-time tool, fires BEFORE formal rate cut
sub_components.b_on_rate_roc: 30-day rate-of-change of O/N interbank (negative = easing) (35% of P1)
sub_components.c_spread_compression: Spread of O/N vs SBV policy rate floor narrowing (25% of P1)

P1_omo_interbank_momentum.current_note: O/N 4.18% is below the 4.5% level threshold, but OMO net injection fell from +10,000bn to +2,000bn in the local observations and the required rising ≥3-week sequence is not stored. Direction is easier; persistence is unconfirmed.

P2_deposit_rate_diffusion.name: Bank Deposit Rate Leading Diffusion

sub_components.a_roc_12m_deposit: 30-day rate-of-change of 12M deposit rate (primary signal — declining = easing anticipated) (50% of P2)
sub_components.b_breadth_diffusion: % of tracked banks cutting 12M rates over rolling 4 weeks (Tier-2 banks weighted 2x) (35% of P2)
sub_components.c_tier2_diffusion: Count of Tier-2 banks who cut BEFORE Tier-1 banks — front-running signal (15% of P2)

P2_deposit_rate_diffusion.current_note: MBS's June 16-bank panel recorded 6 raisers versus 4 cutters across 6-24M rates; July standard 12M rates are mostly stable. At least two cuts exist, but aggregate RoC is not negative, so P2 does not pass.

P3_disinflation_momentum.name: Disinflation Trajectory

sub_components.a_3m_annualized_core: 3m/3m annualized core CPI momentum (vs 4.0% target) — gives mandate-room read months before YoY rolls (70% of P3)
sub_components.b_distance_to_ceiling: Distance of current core from 4.0% ceiling, direction = falling (30% of P3)

P3_disinflation_momentum.lead_time: 1-3 months (as inflation trajectory enables SBV window)

cascade_trigger.description: Opus cascade — AND-logic, not weighted sum. Avoids coincident-averaging.
cascade_trigger.logic: All 4 must hold simultaneously. Either signal alone is noisy (OMO can inject defensively; deposits can drift on competition). Together they confirm SBV intent.
cascade_trigger.alternative_continuous: Score = G1×G2 × (0.45×P1 + 0.35×P2 + 0.20×P3); trigger at >70 for 2 consecutive weeks
cascade_trigger.expected_lead: 2-4 months before formal SBV rate cut

historical_context.use: supporting commentary only — excluded from trigger logic
notes: A collapsing/negative informal premium may accompany inflows, reserve accumulation, lower dollarization, and improving VND confidence. The spread is an indicator/symptom, not the cause of equity returns.
2006–07 also involved WTO accession, large foreign inflows, rapid credit growth, listings expansion, and speculation — not a functional-form transfer.
2012 is the cleaner analogy for FX-confidence-reserves-monetary-easing transmission; magnitude remains UNTESTED for present Vietnam.
